model: Option B — concept ontology (main/data/ontology/sulfur_terms.json) + separate lexeme registry
purpose: A lexeme is a language-specific naming form that refers to a language-neutral concept. lexeme -> names -> concept. A concept may have many lexemes; a lexeme belongs to one language/locale context.
rules: Every lexeme MUST resolve to exactly one governed concept (concept_id is a term_id in main/data/ontology/sulfur_terms.json).
concept_id is an identifier, NOT a language claim. Concepts are language-neutral.
Lexeme language is a fact about the naming form; it is distinct from the language of any source.
A lexeme NEVER creates a route or URL. Knowledge Object Before URL is absolute.
Free-text strings must not substitute for lexeme IDs in governed evidence; evidence references lexeme_id.
Only lexemes genuinely supported by current evidence/claim scope are instantiated.
concept_binding: concept_id resolves to main/data/ontology/sulfur_terms.json term_id (governed henceforth as a language-neutral concept record).

id_rules.rule: Production lexeme IDs start 'LEX-'. Test fixtures start 'TEST-LEX-'. A governed lexeme MUST NOT use a TEST- identifier.

lexemes.notes: German specialist-dictionary (Spektrum Lexikon der Chemie) accepted lexical form for the MoS2 concept. Lexeme-level only; not a concept-level chemical claim. Public URL NOT authorized.
